name: LumenicMenu
author: LensError
description: Replaces the ChilloutVR Main Menu and Quick Menu with a native Rust UI built on Lumenic. Includes live settings search, Quick Menu pinning, UILib/UIExpansionKit mod bridges, and independent menu toggles.
changelog: Fix UILib Right-click Hold false positives on BTKUILib buttons, add Main Menu navigation history stack and root-tab resets, auto-select default content categories, and block Lumenic keyboard forwarding while the in-game virtual keyboard is open.
